content: 1. Sarecycline increases the levels or effects of irinotecan through inhibition of the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Exercise caution and monitor for toxicities. Adjust dosages of P-gp substrates if necessary when co-administered with P-gp inhibitors. 2. Sarecycline increases the levels or effects of irinotecan liposomal via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter inhibition. Monitor closely for toxicities and consider dosage adjustments. 3. Iron dextran complex reduces the levels or effects of sarecycline by inhibiting gastrointestinal (GI) absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 4. Multivalent cation-containing products, such as iron sucrose, magnesium chloride, magnesium citrate, magnesium gluconate, magnesium hydroxide, magnesium oxide, manganese, and molybdenum, impair the absorption of tetracyclines, including sarecycline, potentially reducing their efficacy. Administer these products at least 2 hours before or 4 hours after tetracycline dosing. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. 5. Isotretinoin increases the toxicity of sarecycline through an unknown mechanism. Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative drugs. Co-administration of oral retinoids with tetracyclines may increase the risk of pseudotumor cerebri (benign intracranial hypertension). Monitor closely for symptoms. 6. Sarecycline increases the levels or effects of ivermectin, lapatinib, ledipasvir/sofosbuvir, lenvatinib, linagliptin, loperamide, loratadine, lovastatin, maraviroc, methotrexate, mitomycin, morphine, nadolol, naloxegol, nelfinavir, nicardipine, nilotinib, nintedanib, ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir & dasabuvir (DSC), ondansetron, osimertinib, paclitaxel, paclitaxel protein-bound, paliperidone, pazopanib, and other P-gp substrates by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Monitor closely for toxicities and adjust dosages as needed. 7. Sarecycline decreases the effects of microbiota oral products due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid concurrent use or complete antibiotic regimens 2–4 days before initiating microbiota oral therapy. Monitor closely. 8. Sarecycline decreases the effects of penicillins (e.g., penicillin G aqueous, penicillin G benzathine, penicillin G procaine, penicillin VK, and nafcillin) and oxacillin due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative drugs. Tetracyclines may interfere with the bactericidal action of penicillins. Monitor for reduced therapeutic effects of penicillins if used concomitantly. 9. Sarecycline increases the effects of pancuronium through pharmacodynamic synergism, increasing the risk of respiratory depression. Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative drugs. Monitor closely. 10. Systemic retinoid use, such as palovarotene, in combination with sarecycline has been associated with benign intracranial hypertension (pseudotumor cerebri). Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative drugs. Monitor closely for symptoms. 11. Formation of insoluble complexes with magnesium supplements reduces sarecycline absorption in the GI tract. Administer magnesium 2 hours before or 4 hours after sarecycline. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed.
